newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money rates steady at 3.0 to 3.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money rates steady at 3.0 to 3.10 pct.

text.p: German call money rates were broadly steady on Tuesday at between 3.00 to 3.10 percent with traders saying the market is well positioned to meet anticipated reserve targets.
With rates steady, the Bundesbank was expected to about evenly match the 75 billion mark repo pact which expires on Wednesday.

Bank holdings at the Bundesbank are slightly below an anticipated 40.4 billion mark reserve target for January, but should have little difficulty reaching that level when the end of the month is nearer.
Banks held 39 billion marks with the Bundesbank on Monday, leaving the average for the month at 39.8 billion marks.
Only 100 million marks was borrowed from the Bundesbank's emergency Lombard lending facility.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average FIONA= was set at 3.08167 percent compared with 3.08933 percent.
